Point P is above, point O is on the right side, point N is below and slightly to the left, and point M is on the left side. In the figure, N is connected to P and N is connected to O, forming the inscribed angle ∠PNO with vertex at N, labeled as 56°. The problem asks for m arc PO. Reasoning: ∠PNO is an inscribed angle, and the arc it intercepts is arc PO. According to the inscribed angle theorem, the measure of an inscribed angle is equal to half the measure of the intercepted arc, so m arc PO = 2 × 56° = 112°.
